name: whatsapp-ai-assistant
description: Monorepo for WhatsApp AI Assistant — server (Node) and mobile controller (Flutter)
author: A R S <https://github.com/ars2k03>

scripts.build:apk: cd apps/mobile && flutter build apk --release && APP_NAME=$(grep -E '^name:' pubspec.yaml | head -1 | awk '{print $2}' | tr -d '"') && mkdir -p ../../output && cp build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk "../../output/${APP_NAME}.apk" && echo "APK → output/${APP_NAME}.apk"
